year = 2024
is_leap = (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0)
print('闰年' if is_leap else '平年')

n = 17
is_prime = n > 1
for i in range(2, int(n ** 0.5) + 1):
    if n % i == 0:
        is_prime = False
        break
print('素数' if is_prime else '非素数')

password = 'Abc123'
has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
is_valid = len(password) >= 8 and has_upper and has_lower and has_digit
print('密码有效' if is_valid else '密码无效')

num = 28
divisor_sum = sum(i for i in range(1, num) if num % i == 0)
print('完美数' if divisor_sum == num else '非完美数')

n = 12345
reversed_num = 0
original = n
while n > 0:
    reversed_num = reversed_num * 10 + n % 10
    n //= 10
print('回文数' if original == reversed_num else '非回文数')

n = 28
def is_perfect(n):
    return sum(i for i in range(1, n) if n % i == 0) == n

result = [x for x in range(1, 1001) if is_perfect(x)]
print(result)
